scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev -w shell" "npm run dev -w home" "npm run dev -w video" "npm run dev -w live" "npm run dev -w premium"
scripts.build: npm run build -w home && npm run build -w video && npm run build -w live && npm run build -w premium && npm run build -w shell
scripts.preview: concurrently --kill-others "npm run preview -w shell" "npm run preview -w home" "npm run preview -w video" "npm run preview -w live" "npm run preview -w premium"
